subject.title: fix(signal): detect native bot mentions in group gating

question: Should OpenClaw accept stricter Signal `requireMention=true` behavior for existing groups that have bot identity configured but no text mention regexes?
rationale: The implementation is a clean bug fix, but it changes existing upgrade behavior for a documented Signal group configuration and can reduce message delivery that previously reached the agent.

options.title: Accept stricter native mention gating
options.body: Merge after acknowledging that configured Signal bot identity should make native-only `requireMention=true` groups enforce mention gating.

options.title: Require compatibility first
options.body: Ask for an opt-in, migration, doctor warning, or clearer upgrade warning before changing existing native-only Signal groups from pass-through to gated delivery.

options.title: Pause for broader channel policy
options.body: Hold this PR if maintainers want the downstream mention-facts and source-actor stack reviewed as one larger channel-policy package.

recommendation.title: Accept stricter native mention gating
recommendation.body: Merge after acknowledging that configured Signal bot identity should make native-only `requireMention=true` groups enforce mention gating.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent history on Signal group defaults and the shared inbound mention decision contract.
